items.title: What
items.body:
Digital music notation services. **Transcription** to transform audio into digitized sheet music and MIDI.

**Arrangements** to match your musical setting, level and needs.

items.title: Why
items.body:
To make music notation accessible to all, and to expand music literacy around the globe.

We work with **educators**, **app developers**, **artists**, **publishers**, etc.

items.title: How
items.body:
Through an expert team of highly **specialized musicians** and engineers.

100 % transcribed by human ears, leveraging state-of-the-art technology.

blocks.title: Our values
blocks.body:
### Flexibility

Customized project solutions tailored to your specific needs, leveraging our team of experts.

### Reliability

Consistent, high-quality results you can count on, trusted by over 50,000 satisfied clients.

### Accuracy

100% note-for-note transcriptions, meticulously done by musicians by ear with perfect precision.

### Responsiveness

Quick support from our team of music specialists, with an average response time of just 1–4 hours.

items.title: Music learning apps and music education
items.body:
- MIDI and Music XML transcription to expand your song and exercise catalogs
- Broad musical expertise to absorb your production needs —all instruments, levels, and music genres.
- Backing track production
- Digitization and conversion to your class software

items.title: Karaoke and music gamification
items.body:
- MIDI-to-audio alignment for seamless integration to your systems
- Lead vocals tutorial and feedback for enhanced user experience
- Technical consultancy: sample fonts, file formats, advanced MIDI functionalities, etc.

items.title: Accessible music
items.body:
- Visual solutions to enhance music perception and participation with the hearing-impaired community
- Braille sheet music for the visually impaired community
